title: Dual-Stack Host Cannot Reach IPv6 Server
symptoms: A dual-stack host can reach the IPv4 server but not the IPv6 server
The IPv6 server responds to pings from its local subnet
IPv6 addresses are configured on both routers
The host has both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses assigned
rootCause: IPv6 routing is not enabled on the intermediate router with 'ipv6 unicast-routing'. Without this command, the router does not forward IPv6 packets between interfaces, silently dropping traffic at Layer 3.

steps.prompt: Which command shows whether IPv6 routing is enabled on the router?
steps.hint: If interfaces show IPv6 addresses but no global routing, the command is missing.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the IPv6 routing table?
steps.hint: If the table only has link-local entries, unicast routing is not enabled.

steps.prompt: Which command confirms IPv6 unicast routing is configured?
steps.hint: This command must appear in the global config for IPv6 forwarding to work.
